title.narrative: Support to food security of 200 families of Tubimbi and 50 families in Kinkole Kinshasa

description.narrative: This project is the continuation of the DRC276 designed in 2013 to support returnees in Tubimbi, South Kivu, for the recovery of their livelihoods and allow orphans return back to school by developing livelihoods skill that generate easily necessary funds. The project aims also to support the most vulnerables of Kinkole surrounding Kinshasa to recover and streghten their livelihoods means.The assessment made in August 2013 by FAAFAD indicates a high vulnerability in food security. The same report indicates that in previous clashes, many people have lost their lives which cause a large number of orphans. The latter have difficulties to return back to school because they have no one to take care of. The report of the partner FAAFAD indicates that some of these orphans had manifested great interest to do a small business breeding of guinea-pigs that allow them to earn some money that can support their studies. The first phase of the project coded DRC276 supported the livelihood recovery of 120 families and 50 orphans in Tubimbi and 50 families in Maluku. This project which is the continuation of the DRC276 aims to support 200 families in Tubimbi and 40 families of fishermen in Kinkole.FAAFAD needs us$30,313.00 to support the rehabilitation of these families and orphans in food security. The main objective of the project is to ensure food security for 200 families in distress in Tubimbi South Kivu and 50 families of fishermen in Kinkole.
